unsuitable: Essential labels that must appear immediately
react-bits:blur-text.selection: Use a single reveal to establish hierarchy; leave the rest of the page readable from first paint.
integration: Wrap with a semantic heading; the component itself renders a paragraph.
Use word animation and a short delay. Replace with plain text for reduced motion.
Requires motion; confirm heading wraps at narrow widths.
accessibility: Avoid duplicate screen-reader text when adding a fallback.
Keep the complete message available without animation.
react-bits:blur-text.reducedMotion: Use a static text branch; source references do not prove a complete reduced-motion path.

performance.reason: Small text DOM animation, but blur and many letters increase paint work.

react-bits:count-up.selection: Keep labels, units and precision fixed; animation should not delay comprehension.
integration: Requires motion. Reserve enough width to prevent digit layout shifts.
Provide the final formatted value to assistive technology and reduced-motion users.
accessibility: Hide changing visual digits from screen readers and expose one stable value.
react-bits:count-up.reducedMotion: Render the final number directly when reduced motion is requested.

performance.reason: Few animated numbers are inexpensive; many simultaneous counters can cause layout work.

react-bits:fade-content.selection: Choose a short entrance on one supporting block; do not cascade the entire interface.
integration: Requires GSAP and ScrollTrigger. Keep content visible in a static fallback.
In Next.js place below a client boundary. Review effect cleanup when navigating.
accessibility: Focus must never land on hidden controls.
react-bits:fade-content.reducedMotion: Bypass the wrapper and render children directly.

performance.reason: Opacity and short translation on a small section; scroll triggers still add overhead.

unsuitable: Every card in a data grid
react-bits:animated-content.selection: Use only when the entrance supports the reading sequence.
integration: Requires GSAP. Constrain distance and duration.
Check scroll-trigger behavior after route changes and dynamic content.
accessibility: Do not animate focused content out of view.

performance.reason: Scroll triggers and large moving content can add main-thread and compositing work.

suitable: A small set of marketing feature cards
react-bits:spotlight-card.selection: Use a faint spotlight within an already well-composed card; keep text contrast independent of it.
integration: React-only runtime in the indexed variant. Style the surface for the existing palette.
Pointer appearance is decoration; actions remain native buttons or links inside the card.
accessibility: Do not turn a generic div into the only clickable control.
Check text contrast at the brightest spot.
react-bits:spotlight-card.reducedMotion: Use an ordinary styled card if the source still responds excessively to pointer movement.

performance.reason: Pointer tracking and surface painting; limit the number and area of cards.

suitable: One primary marketing call to action
react-bits:star-border.selection: A moving border is a strong accent; use it once and keep the label calm.
integration: Inspect polymorphic element props and retain button or anchor semantics.
Constrain the border to a small area; test hover and focus independently.
accessibility: The animated border must not be the only focus indicator.
react-bits:star-border.reducedMotion: Replace with a static border or disable the animation.

performance.reason: Continuous canvas or border rendering can add work even on a small control.

unsuitable: Full-page continuous motion on low-power targets
react-bits:shape-grid.selection: Keep the grid faint, clipped to the hero, and separated from text by a solid surface.
integration: Canvas 2D; give the parent explicit dimensions.
Use a low speed and remove pointer interception. Keep the canvas decorative.
accessibility: Set the wrapper aria-hidden and ensure text contrast without the effect.
react-bits:shape-grid.reducedMotion: Unmount the canvas and use a static CSS grid instead; speed zero may still schedule frames.

performance.reason: Canvas repaint loop scales with area and pixel density.

react-bits:squish-switch.selection: Use for a low-stakes setting where a small tactile response clarifies state.
integration: Requires motion. Prefer controlled checked/onChange props.
Supply ariaLabel and test Space, Enter, pointer and disabled states.
Persist state in the application; the component is only presentation.
accessibility: Check switch role, accessible name and aria-checked; source support is not certification.
react-bits:squish-switch.reducedMotion: Source references useReducedMotion; validate the controlled state and provide a native checkbox fallback if needed.

performance.reason: A single spring-driven thumb is small; avoid animating entire settings rows.

react-bits:shiny-text.selection: A brief shimmer can emphasize a secondary label, but the text must read at its dimmest state.
integration: Check the variant dependencies and contrast across gradient positions.
Use a solid text color for static and reduced-motion branches.
accessibility: Do not use low-opacity gradient text for essential instructions.
react-bits:shiny-text.reducedMotion: Render plain text or a disabled/static state verified in source.

performance.reason: Animated text paint; long text and simultaneous instances increase cost.

react-bits:split-text.selection: Prefer words to letters unless the brand calls for a theatrical reveal.
integration: Requires GSAP; inspect SplitText integration and font-loading behavior.
Preserve a semantic heading and check wrapping after fonts load.
accessibility: Ensure split text does not create fragmented screen-reader output.

performance.reason: Text splitting and per-letter animation create many nodes and layout dependencies.

react-bits:decrypted-text.selection: Reserve scrambling for nonessential copy that can tolerate momentary ambiguity.
integration: Supply a readable final state. Keep the activation intentional.
Check the live region strategy before animating changes.
accessibility: Expose the final phrase as a stable accessible name.

performance.reason: Repeated character updates can trigger DOM work.

suitable: A brand-coloured word in a hero
react-bits:gradient-text.selection: Derive the gradient from the brand and test every colour stop against its background.
integration: Inspect animation props and provide a static brand colour.
Do not use gradient alone to indicate a link or state.
accessibility: Measure the lowest contrast across the gradient.
react-bits:gradient-text.reducedMotion: Freeze the gradient or use a solid colour.

performance.reason: Small text regions are modest; perpetual gradients still repaint.

react-bits:click-spark.selection: Keep sparks scoped to one optional interaction; normal state feedback does the real work.
integration: Canvas-based decoration. Preserve the child control event handlers.
Do not intercept pointer events needed for selection or forms.
accessibility: Native keyboard behavior and visible success text must remain.
react-bits:click-spark.reducedMotion: Unmount the spark wrapper or render children directly.

performance.reason: Burst rendering is bounded but repeated clicks can accumulate particles.

react-bits:magnet.selection: Use only where slight pointer displacement will not make the target harder to acquire.
integration: Keep displacement small and target dimensions stable.
Retain native focus styles and a touch-safe layout.
accessibility: Keyboard users need a stationary control with equal functionality.

performance.reason: Pointer-driven transforms on a few elements are modest.

react-bits:glare-hover.selection: Treat glare as material detail and keep it away from important text.
integration: Check hover behavior on touch and disable when pointer is coarse.
Keep the content in a stable stacking layer.
accessibility: Do not conceal content on focus or hover.
react-bits:glare-hover.reducedMotion: Use a static surface and border.

performance.reason: Surface transforms and gradients add paint/compositing work.

suitable: A small partner strip with meaningful logos
react-bits:logo-loop.selection: Prefer a static logo row first; motion is justified only when it improves a compact showcase.
integration: Set image dimensions and provide local, licensed logo assets.
Expose a pause mechanism for continuous movement.
accessibility: Avoid repeating accessible names for visual clones; label meaningful logos.
react-bits:logo-loop.reducedMotion: Render a wrapping static list of logos.

performance.reason: Continuous transforms and duplicated content consume resources.

react-bits:aurora.selection: Select only when the atmosphere is central to the brand; keep it to one bounded section.
integration: Inspect OGL/WebGL requirements and test GPU fallback.
Set explicit dimensions, reduce resolution and hide when offscreen.
accessibility: Keep the background decorative and text on a contrast-stable surface.
react-bits:aurora.reducedMotion: Replace with a static colour treatment and do not mount the renderer.

performance.reason: GPU shader loop, canvas size and device pixel ratio can be expensive.

react-bits:dot-grid.selection: Use as a framed illustration with restrained pointer response.
integration: Inspect animation dependencies and container sizing.
Make the effect pointer-transparent when behind controls.
accessibility: Do not encode essential data in decorative dots.
react-bits:dot-grid.reducedMotion: Use a static CSS dot pattern.

performance.reason: Large dot counts and pointer reactions increase work.

react-bits:tilted-card.selection: Use modest tilt on one visual artifact; maintain a stable caption and link.
integration: Set explicit image dimensions and meaningful alt text.
Check touch fallback and pointer cleanup after unmount.
accessibility: Make the actual navigation a native link with a visible focus state.
react-bits:tilted-card.reducedMotion: Use an ordinary figure and caption.

performance.reason: Perspective transforms and pointer springs add compositing work.

suitable: A small set of binary preferences
react-bits:spring-check.selection: Use a subtle state transition only after the semantic checked state is clear.
integration: Inspect controlled props, accessible name and disabled behavior.
Keep validation and persistence in the application.
accessibility: Test Space, label activation and checked state with assistive technology.
react-bits:spring-check.reducedMotion: Inspect source support; substitute a styled native checkbox if necessary.

performance.reason: Small spring-driven geometry; many instances should be checked on slower devices.
